title: MBCP L1 deletion receipt (v0)
description: Receipt artifact emitted by the L1 deletion service, L4-attested (SPEC 1.2.6 Round B): the envelope carries a deterministic ed25519 attestation_sig over the canonical bytes of {integrity, receipt} (everything except the sig itself), produced by the issuing service root's per-root keypair; the receipt body embeds the key_id fingerprint and attestation_pubkey. Scope: the attestation proves the issuing root's key signed these bytes — it is strengthening of the attestation record, NOT third-party certification (no trust root; an out-of-band pubkey anchor is required for third-party verification).

attestation_sig.description: Deterministic ed25519 signature (hex128) over the canonical bytes of this envelope WITHOUT the attestation_sig field — binds the integrity block and the whole receipt body (SPEC 1.2.6). Missing or non-verifying signatures are typed rejects; there is no verify-without-signature mode.

inventory.description: Store-set binding (audit §13): the sorted list of ALL bundle ids in the service root at deletion time (pre-deletion state) plus the canonical SHA-256 over that sorted list. Order-independent by construction. Receipts issued before this block existed do not validate against this schema revision.

derived_artifacts_verified.description: L1 cannot prove L3. Always false in a v0 L1 receipt.

key_id.description: Short fingerprint of attestation_pubkey (SHA-256[:16]) — the reserved key-rotation anchor (rotation semantics deferred, SPEC 1.2.6). Must match the embedded pubkey.

attestation_pubkey.description: ed25519 public key of the issuing service root, embedded so the signature is verifiable from the artifact alone (SPEC 1.2.6). Verification is against THIS embedded key; binding the key to an identity needs an out-of-band anchor.

supersedes.description: receipt_digest (integrity.digest) of the receipt this receipt supersedes. Format check only: chain existence/digest-match/acyclicity are runtime verify_receipt checks — JSON Schema cannot express graph constraints (SPEC 1.2.2).
